title: Penguin Body Mass Analysis

Average body mass by species

average_mass <- penguins_clean |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(mean_body_mass_g = mean(body_mass_g))

average_mass

title: Penguin Body Mass Analysis
text:
Body mass comparison

ggplot(penguins_clean, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body mass (g)"
  )







Figure 1: Body mass distribution of Palmer Penguins by species.

title: Penguin Body Mass Analysis
text:
Findings
The results show differences in body mass among the three penguin species. Gentoo penguins have a higher average body mass than Adelie and Chinstrap penguins. The boxplot also shows the distribution of body mass within each species.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Starting the MDS program at UBC has been both exciting and challenging. During orientation, I was excited to meet my classmates and learn more about the program, but I also felt a little overwhelmed by how fast-paced everything seemed. Coming from a life sciences background, I knew that learning programming and new technical tools would be a big part of this journey.
The first weeks of classes have introduced me to Python, R, statistics, and many new tools and concepts. One thing that surprised me most was the pace of the program. There is a lot to learn in a short amount of time, and some of the labs have been challenging, but each time I work through a problem I feel that I am making progress.
I am still adjusting to the intensity of the program, but I am becoming more comfortable with the material every day. I know there will be many challenges ahead, but I am excited to continue developing my skills and see how much I can learn throughout the MDS program.



Orientation day on campus.

Body mass comparison

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.bar(
    average_mass["species"],
    average_mass["body_mass_g"]
)

Figure 1: Average body mass of Palmer Penguins by species.

title: Penguin Data Analysis with Python
text:
Findings
The results show that Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass. Adelie and Chinstrap penguins have similar average body masses, while Gentoo penguins are noticeably heavier.

title: About me
text:
Why Data Science
My experience in research sparked my interest in using data to answer scientific and healthcare questions. I joined the MDS program at UBC to develop my skills in programming, statistics, and data analysis. My goal is to combine my background in life sciences with data science and explore opportunities in healthcare and biomedical research.

title: About me
text:
Outside of Data Science
Outside of studying and data science, I enjoy spending time with my family, exploring new places, baking, and cooking. I especially enjoy trying new recipes and sharing food with family and friends.
